mapper.select: SELECT * FROM xxl_kettle_file WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND file_name = #{fileName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xxl_kettle_file(group_id, file_name, file_type, file_path, file_size, version, job_id, remark, add_time, update_time) VALUES(#{groupId}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{version}, #{jobId}, #{remark}, #{addTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE xxl_kettle_file SET file_size=#{fileSize}, version=#{version}, job_id=#{jobId}, remark=#{remark}, update_time=#{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
